member.name: T:BattleCardEnhancedView.CardViewControls

member.name: M:BattleCardEnhancedView.CardViewControls.AddIgnoredCard(BattleDiceCardUI)
member.summary: Prevents a specific card from claiming the "zoomed card" role when opened (which also causes the previous zoomed card, if any, to reset its scale).
member.param: A card that should ignored by the zooming function.

member.name: M:BattleCardEnhancedView.CardViewControls.RemoveIgnoredCard(BattleDiceCardUI)
member.summary: Enables a specific card to claim the "zoomed card" role when opened (which also causes the previous zoomed card, if any, to reset its scale). This only has any effect if the card was previously set to be ignored with - the default setting for an unspecified card is "do not ignore"!
member.param: A card that should no longer be ignored by the zooming function.

member.name: M:BattleCardEnhancedView.CardViewControls.BlockCardZoom(System.Object)
member.summary: Temporarily disables scroll-zooming. For compatibility with other simultaneous consumers, this requires an "anchor" object that will keep scrolling disabled. Scroll-zoooming will be disabled as long as at least one "anchor" remains in use. To remove an "anchor", use . (Note that an anchor that gets garbage-collected is no longer considered in use!)
member.param: An object that will prevent scroll-zooming until it is removed with or garbage-collected.
